audit.whatIsWrong: diff read HARD while tone is the green favoured colour, diffRating is 4/10, and report[14] says 'Favoured matchup'. The page told the user two opposite things.
audit.why: 50.79% over 518 games — the largest sample in this slice — with an early-game bully into a hard scaler. Every other field on the page already says favoured; only the diff token disagreed.
audit.corrected: diff HARD -> FAV, matching tone, diffRating 4/10 and report[14].

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 given to Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 given to Skill, and 2+ items given to Mordekaiser — all three contradict the packet chart and the page's own whys text.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill, Kayle, and the mirror set exactly that. whys[0] says neither has a level-1 all-in; whys[3] says you punish every step off the wave; whys[6] says she out-scales hard. Kayle at two items is the single clearest scaling flip in the game and the page handed it to Mordekaiser.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was tracked as 'her get-out at 6' with no number, and Starfire Spellblade's auto reset was never mentioned.
audit.why: Kit file: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s — at rank 1 it is down for nearly three minutes, which is the whole reason the 6-to-first-item window exists. Starfire Spellblade is a 6-8s auto reset that scales on missing health, so her burst tell is the wind-up, not a cast. Radiant Blast is 900 range on 12/11/10/9/8s and reduces your resistances before she commits.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry the real cooldowns and the auto-reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentioned Grievous Wounds against Celestial Blessing.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal at 900 range — in a lane you win by extended aura grinding, her sustain is what turns your won trade into an even one.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names the 15s heal and the anti-heal timing.

edits.before: Track Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln): Her get-out at 6. Bait it. When it is down — R her — the realm is yours.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s — bait it, then R. Starfire Spellblade is her auto reset: step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 160/120/80s — bait it, then commit. Her Q shreds your resists first.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Late she answers your 100s R with an 80s Divine Judgment and out-ranges you.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s and Divine Judgment answers it on 160/120/80s — if her ult is up, your R buys her a free reset, not a kill.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn carries his extended trades), then Riftmaker; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Lost Chapter component / Bami's (≈900-1300g).
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment (burn beats her sustain), then Riftmaker; boots Mercury's Treads. Celestial Blessing heals every 15s — Grievous Wounds before long trades.

notes: Largest sample in the slice (518 games) and the level chart handed Kayle's 2+ item window to Mordekaiser — the worst possible row to get wrong on the hardest scaler in the game. Fixed in matched pairs. diff token flipped HARD -> FAV because tone, diffRating and report[14] all already said favoured; the page was self-contradictory, not the win rate. Both packet suspectNames (Divine Judgment's / Save Divine Judgment) are false positives. As with kassadin, the derived 'grounding' flag on Mordekaiser's Q is not in Riot's Obliterate text and was not asserted.
